content.text: This image shows the calendars of Marcus Lee, Kenji Watanabe, Sofia Moreno, Tom Becker, Elena Ruiz and Daniel Park for one work week (Mon to Fri, 8:00 to 18:00). message.content:

On Thursday, everyone is free from 10:30 to 11:15, but that is only 45 minutes. Elena and Daniel have meetings continuing until 12:15. From 12:15 until 13:15, all six calendars are clear, so that is the earliest full hour.

FINAL ANSWER: Thu 12:15
